profile.headline: Software Developer (Consultant) at University of Central Florida
profile.summary: More than 7 years of experience designing and developing web applications. Proficient in Object-Oriented Design, Software and Front-End develpment. Team player.

positions.title: Software Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Developed a Web application designated to handle all operations related with sponsorship accounts for people who come to work at the University as a Consultant. The application also contains a separate Console App for all schedule tasks.
●	UI/Frontend using ASP.NET Core MVC5, HTML5, jQuery, AJAX, Twitter Bootstrap and CSS3, Fluent Validation.
●	Backend Development using C#, LINQ to SQL Server, Entity Framework, .Net Core, Code First, Ioc Unity. 
●	Agile development with Scrum, Azure DevOps platform, continuous integration.
●	Creating Email notifications with RazorLightEngine.
●	Creating and editing Automatic Process as part of the Tasks.
●	Gathered and analyzed requirements, identified and resolved issues. Tracked and fixed defects.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Remote-Contractor)
positions.description:
Developed an integrate Life Insurance Platform hosted in Azure Cloud. This system is divided by a common API Rest, several web applications and a couple of Azure Functions. 
●	UI/Frontend using Azure App Services, ASP.NET MVC5, HTML5, jQuery, AJAX, Twitter Bootstrap and CSS3.
●	Backend Development using C#, LINQ to SQL Server, Entity Framework, Restful API, .Net Framework, Code First, Swagger API UI.
●	Creating Cloud Framework to run asynchronous Tasks and Schedules Tasks in the cloud using Azure Functions Apps and azure SignalR to track all changes in real time.
●	Creating and editing Automatic Process as part of the Tasks.
●	Gathered and analyzed requirements, identified and resolved issues. Tracked and fixed defects.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer (Contractor)
positions.description:
Developed a Sales Web Application designated to sale products in Volcano Bay Park of Universal Studios Orlando.
Angular 5 application with Bootstrap 4 as Front-End framework, SASS, TypeScript, GIT, HTML 5 VS Code.
Creating and Editing components and services in Angular 5.
Consuming NodeJS ResFul API services.
Creating Unit tests using Jasmine and Mocha / Karma.
Creating End-to End test using Protractor.
Gathered and analyzed requirements, identified and resolved issues. Tracked and fixed defects.

positions.title: Software developer .NET
positions.description:
Developed an integrated health insurance platform for leading international health care organization multi-layer distributed application that automates the company’s operations and improves performance. The system is divided into a Core application that is exposed through a set of WCF services and web portals (member portal and agent portal) that allow the management of information related to the policies.
Worked as a software developer fixing bugs and making enhancement. Specialized in the management and distribution of documents and web portals reports, using integrate systems

positions.title: Contract Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked as web developer in developing team. Developing an online processing system accounting documents and cloud services.
•	Developed asynchronous Tasks and Schedules Tasks in the cloud using IronWorker and Amazon DataPipeline.
•	Created Abstraction Layer to interact with Azure Cloud System and Queue task using its API and its services.
•	Create desktop applications as tools to support the development in C#.
•	Responsible for modifying and extending reporting capabilities within the vault system.
•	Designed and developed backend and frontend for dynamic database driven websites.
•	Carry out quality insurance tests to discover errors and optimize usability.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Hired to develop and maintain a web application to automate the  processes related to operations within the library
•	Handle the task of developing and creating an Symfony php  application as per the specifications.
•	Designed and created the structure of entities to generate the MySQL database using Doctrine ORM.
•	Gathered, analyzed and implemented requirements; identified and resolved issues; fixed and
tracked bugs.

positions.title: Software Designer & Developer
positions.description: Participated of the development ZERA Learning Management System for Alfaomega Grupo Editor, developing functionalities for the Library Module. This development was done using symfony framework (PHP)  jQuery, jQuery UI, CSS, Javascript, XML, YAML, PostgreSQL. Captured and formally described requirements. Designed and developed functionalities, including developer tests.
